{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|So, there I was, crouched in the darkwoode tree branch, twenty meters&mdash;well more like twenty-five&mdash;above the lush jungle floor.|[[Luskin Exovar]]|<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
'''Darkwoode trees''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. They could reach heights of over twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. [[Luskin Exovar]] once engaged an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] in a darkwoode forest, and decapitated it with a [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutter]].<ref name="WHSV" />
